verses.uhibbu-mina-d-dunya-taba-i-a-ahliha-c1-v: ʾuḥibbu mina d-dunyā ṭabāʾiʿa ʾahlihā wafī ḥubbihā ḥubbu lladhī khalaqa d-dunyā
fafī kulli shayʾi lil-mufakkiri ḥikmahu taqūdu dhawī l-ʾalbābi lil-ḥikmahi l-ʿulyā
ʾidhā mā ʾaṣāba l-bardu fal-bardu ʿibratu waʾin mā ʾaṣāba l-ḥarru fal-ḥarru mā ʾaḥyā
tarā sh-shamsa nūrā bil-ḥayāti tamuddunā warīḥu l-hawāʾi ṭ-ṭalqi yūrithuhā l-ghunyā
fafī ḥasharāti l-ʾarḍi ʾalfu ʿajībati wajadtu ʿuqūla n-nāsi min ḥaṣrihā taʿyā
